dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the Foundation of the Federal Bar Association, its board of directors, officers, members, and employees.
dimensions.evidence: revise the Federal charter for the Foundation of the Federal Bar Association.

dimensions.assessment: Modifies internal corporate governance rules, permitted compensation structures, loan prohibitions, and dissolution asset distribution procedures.
dimensions.evidence: revises the federal charter for the Foundation of the Federal Bar Association to shift authority from the charter to the bylaws.

dimensions.assessment: Has no direct federal spending or revenue implications, as noted by compliance with statutory pay-as-you-go requirements through congressional budget statements.
dimensions.evidence: The budgetary effects of this Act... shall be determined by reference to the latest statement titled 'Budgetary Effects of PAYGO Legislation'

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 36, United States Code, to update specific statutory provisions governing a single federally chartered corporation.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 36, United States Code, to revise the Federal charter for the Foundation of the Federal Bar Association.

dimensions.assessment: Makes permanent statutory amendments to the organization's federal charter.

missing_information: Specific financial figures regarding the foundation's asset size or employee compensation levels are not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: Revises the federal charter for the Foundation of the Federal Bar Association by shifting structural governance authorities from the charter to the bylaws and updating restrictions on political activities, compensation, and asset distribution.
